SELECT s.region, s.format, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_lines,
 min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_gross,
 min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS minload, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.store_id, s.region, f.sale_date, w.status, w.dispatch_date,
         COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
         f.gross_amount, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
)
SELECT region, store_id = 999 AS is999, category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, coalesce(status,'store') AS status,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_disp,
  sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_disp,
  sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_order,
  sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_order,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE store_id=900 AND dispatch_date IS NULL) AS web_no_dispatch
FROM lines
WHERE (business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30') OR (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS mth, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store_ver_off,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prod_ver_off
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.net_amount, f.vat_rate, f.gross_amount, f.sale_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE w.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'web straddle Aug-order/Sep-dispatch' AS what, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g, sum(net_amount*0.255) AS extra_if_255 FROM l WHERE sale_date<=DATE '2024-08-31' AND dd>=DATE '2024-09-01' AND dd<=DATE '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'physical stores gross Aug-Sep vs rpt before returns (net)', count(*), (SELECT sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND r.store_id<900),
  (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
FROM (SELECT 1)
